name: 3D Chain Code Representation
aliases: 3D Chain Code Representation of Voxelised Solids
Chain code traversal and pruning algorithm for voxelised solids
definition: A method for representing voxelised solids by encoding their boundary surfaces as hierarchical lists of chain codes, enabling explicit spatial relationships and topology queries.
summary: The 3D Chain Code Representation encodes voxelized solid surfaces into a Hierarchical List of Chains, enabling explicit handling of complex geometries with holes and cavities while generating shorter, more compressible sequences through path pruning.
